text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- President Guntis Ulmanis continues his visit to Poland, where he has already signed a free trade deal. The agenda includes a meeting with Lithuanian and Polish businessmen.
- Riga city will tomorrow end the heating season, meaning it will start turning off the heating in peoples homes.
- The parliament committee investigating the use of credits from the G24 sat again. It said it has no clear idea of who was responsible for distributing the loans.
- The libel case of the Social Democratic Party continues against Prime Minister Andris Shkele.
- The human rights and social affairs parliament committee backed new legislation on the treatment of refugees.
- Latvia and Norway continue talks on the readmission of illegal immigrants, expected to visa-free travel between the two nations.
